prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production Layout mode HUD button for the Fishius aquarium game.
Primary request: one simple FOUR-ARROW MOVE icon in a rounded-square cream-and-gold button. Exactly four chunky turquoise arrows joined at the center, pointing straight up, down, left and right. A familiar four-way move cursor shape. Symmetric, very bold and easy to read at 40 to 64 pixels. No diagonal arrows.
Style: polished hand-painted 2D casual aquarium game art. The tile matches the existing Food and Sell tools: warm cream center, softly golden bottom, thin warm brown outside outline, slim ivory inner bevel and subtle gold rim highlights. The four-way arrow is painted saturated teal/turquoise, with a thin darker teal outline and broad restrained aqua highlights. Friendly rounded edges. No heavy 3D extrusion.
Composition: exactly one upright rounded square tile facing straight ahead. Tile centered and occupying about 88 percent of the square image. Four-arrow symbol occupies about 70 percent of the tile and is centered both ways. All artwork is inside the tile, no objects protrude.
Background: true RGBA transparency outside the rounded-square tile. Opaque cream tile interior. Do not draw a checkerboard. High-resolution square PNG.
Constraints: only the tile and four-arrow symbol. NO pencil, NO blueprint, NO net, NO words, NO letters, NO labels, NO fish, NO extra buttons, NO scene, NO sparkles, NO external drop shadow.
transparency: Original generated alpha preserved. File copied without image edits. All four corners have alpha 0.
